passages.text: And he answered me, and said, You do not hasten more than the Most High: for your haste is for your own self, but he that is above hastens on behalf of many.
passages.note: Impatience for things to happen on your own timeline

passages.text: For what is gone I know, but what is for to come I know not.

Then I awaked, and an extreme trembling went through my body, and my mind was troubled, so that it fainted. So the angel that was come to talk with me held me, comforted me, and set me up upon my feet.
passages.note: Overwhelming fear, then being held and comforted
